# Filter rows for the years 2003 and 2007
df_2003 = df[df['Year'] == 2003]
df_2007 = df[df['Year'] == 2007]

# Get the unique competitions for each year
competitions_2003 = set(df_2003['Competition'].unique())
competitions_2007 = set(df_2007['Competition'].unique())

# Find competitions that appear in both years
common_competitions = competitions_2003.intersection(competitions_2007)

# Since the question asks for which competition in 2003 appears in the same year as 2007,
# it likely means which competition from 2003 also occurred in 2007.
# The only competition that appears in both years is "All-Africa Games"
answer = list(common_competitions)[0] if len(common_competitions) == 1 else list(common_competitions)
